summary: Recovered the universal Guide pre-dispatch compile gate and closed a live CI enforcement gap. The compiled-dispatch implementation already validates the E1-E10 contract, fresh-worker WorkBlocks, consumer/organism binding, semantic dedupe, orphan rejection, exact capacity derivation, failure ordering and selective correction; the A-I harness plus Shell/Chats/Organism dogfood receipt already exercised those semantics. However current Prometeo Live Feed neither directly executed guide_pre_dispatch_compile_gate_v1.mjs nor watched changes to scripts/compiled-dispatch-contract-lib.mjs / the harness, so this universal gate could regress without blocking allocator publication. Patched the existing Live Feed workflow only: added both files to push paths and added the exact A-I/dogfood harness immediately after the existing recursive Guide harness. GitHub Actions run 37022705794 then completed the full 'Build claim-ready execution + role allocator' step successfully with the new gate in place. No new planner, scheduler, queue, CURRENT, Work Graph, plan authority or persistence surface was introduced.
